svg.title: Cecil separates true, false and unknown while Vale pairs accuracy with failure conditions.
svg.desc: Three blank value cards sit on separate rails. Riju gives the unknown rail a review branch, while Vale places a failure-condition pane directly beside the accuracy claim.
svg.text: Page 56, panel 1 · Top-oblique view of Cecil's three value rails

text.tspan: The group makes uncertainty visible and prevents
recommendation from becoming a hidden decision.
